text:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up — our SI partner is doing a customer showcase next week and wants to pull the Marketplace webhook samples. Marketplace is changing the webhook payload slightly (envelope + timestamp) and it will be incompatible with SDKs < 3.0. We need a coordination plan.
Owen (sdk): Can you paste the exact payload diff? If it's just an envelope rename we can add a tolerant parser in a patch release (3.0.1) and a compatibility shim for older clients.
Priya (infra): Current payload (snippet): `{
  "event": "model.inference",
  "signature": "sha256=BASE64",
  "ts": 1618290000
}`
Priya (infra): New payload will move signature into header `X-Marketplace-Sig: v1;ts=1618291200;hmac=HEX` and rename `event` -> `type`. Also we'll include a `request_id` field.
Owen (sdk): That explains the break. Proposed SDK plan: 1) Accept old `event` and new `type` keys; 2) Accept signature in old body field or new header `X-Marketplace-Sig`; 3) Add a runtime opt-in env var `MARKETPLACE_SIG_STRICT=true` default false for 14 days. Patch release 3.0.1 with fallback parsing + tests.
Hiro (si-partner): For our demo we can target customers on staging that have the latest SDK, but many enterprise customers are on pinned versions. Is there a way to dual-emit both formats from Marketplace during a transition?
Priya (infra): Yes, we can dual-emit for a configurable window. Ops can run dual-mode for 10 days. We'll also put a banner in the Marketplace console and send an email to partner contacts.
Maya (partnerships): Good. Please confirm owners: SDK implements fallback (Owen), Infra toggles dual-emission and provides a feature flag for Dedicated/Private (Priya), Partnerships drafts partner comms + coordination checklist (Maya).
Owen (sdk): I'll open a PR with the tolerant parser and add code samples for py/node/java. Tests will cover both header and body signature verification. ETA PR today, canary tomorrow morning.
Priya (infra): We'll expose `MARKETPLACE_SIG_STRICT` in Dedicated/Private via config service and in hosted via runtime flag. Deploy plan: staging -> canary -> prod. console-bot: Canary scheduled for marketplace-sig-dualmode on staging at 03:00 UTC.
Hiro (si-partner): For the customer showcase I need stable sample payloads. Can Partnerships provide a small compatibility doc + sample curl examples we can embed?
Maya (partnerships): Will do. I'll draft a short compat guide: examples, timeline, fallback flag info, and FAQ for SI partners. Posting to #partnerships-docs by EOD.
Owen (sdk): Also proposing telemetry: emit metric `marketplace.signature.fallback` when old format is used. That will help decide when to turn strict on.
Priya (infra): Agreed. We'll add that metric and a dashboard. We'll trigger an alert if fallback usage > 5% after 72h.
Maya (partnerships): Communications plan: 1) Banner + console notice today, 2) Partner email 48h before switch, 3) Dual-emission day-of, 4) Strict flip after 10 days if fallback < 5%. If fallback > 5%, we'll extend and schedule a partner outreach sweep.
Hiro (si-partner): Sounds good — we'll retarget our demo to customers with SDK >= 3.0 to be safe and ask Partnerships for a short blurb.
Owen (sdk): PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/522 — includes parser, tests, and code samples. Canary builds attached.
Priya (infra): Canary pass on staging at 03:15 UTC. Scheduling canary to prod in 2h after smoke tests.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks — looping in Partner Success for customer outreach. If anyone hits blockers, post here and I'll escalate.
Owen (sdk): Noted. I'll monitor telemetry and bump a hotfix if needed.
Maya (partnerships): Closing loop — will post the draft partner email shortly and tag relevant SI contacts.
